run-script.name: Run Script
run-script.description: Run a shell command against the cloned repository in a throwaway container

config.runScriptImageDescription: Docker image the command runs in. Choose one that already carries the tooling the script needs.
config.runScriptPackagesDescription: Installed in the container before the command runs, using the image's package manager (apk, apt, dnf, yum, zypper or pacman).
